tests.instrument: Digital scale, 0.1 g resolution or better, calibrated with a known mass
tests.pass_rule: Pass when the measured value is <= 120 g.
procedure: Assemble the prototype as it will be deployed: hull, lid, electronics, battery, seals.
Zero the scale. Place the assembled prototype on it and wait for a stable reading.
Record the mass in grams. Repeat three times, removing the prototype each time.
Use the mean of the three readings as the measured mass.
tests.statement: The total mass of the bracket shall not exceed 120 g.
tests.title: Mass of the assembled prototype

tests.instrument: Calipers or steel ruler, 0.1 mm resolution; the printer's stated bed size
tests.pass_rule: Pass when the measured value is = 1 ratio.
procedure: Measure the printed hull's three bounding dimensions in millimetres. Do this on the printed part, not on the CAD file.
Sort the three dimensions and the three bed dimensions in ascending order.
The part fits if each sorted dimension is no larger than the matching bed dimension.
Record the result as 1 (fits) or 0 (does not fit), with the dimensions.
tests.statement: The bracket shall fit within the print bed.
tests.title: Printed hull fits the print bed
